note: Reference classifications written by claude:qat#sub-01GZK2K-qat2 before any run (2026-11-07). A key is a claim, not truth: graders may dispute it, and items where the two graders split on a key go to the owner. 'acceptable' lists other answers a careful reader could defend. Items marked seen_in_design also appear (inline) in the tool's design-time eval file, so they are not held out from the builder; tally reports results with and without them.
